description: Export signed receipts already stored in this MCP installation, optionally limited to one farming wallet address. Returns JSON with count and receipt payloads, so use it only where local receipt data is appropriate to expose. It does not create a receipt, validate a claim, contact Base, or submit a transaction; use get_aipou_status instead for a compact private summary.

wallet.description: Optional 20-byte farming wallet address filter. Omit it to export every locally stored receipt.

name: export_ai_receipts
